suspension.spring_rate_front.description: Front coil spring rate (at the spring)

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Remove a front spring and load-test it (or measure wire diameter d, mean coil diameter D and active coils n: k = G d^4 / (8 D^3 n), G = 79.3 GPa). Precision +/-3 %.
candidates.notes: Basis: two leads, neither for the target. Spoon Sports gives the JDM FL1 1.5T hatch 'normal rate' F 2.7 kgf/mm (26.5 N/mm); a CivicXI owner gives 27.0 N/mm for a 2023 Si sedan. The two agree, but the NA Sport Touring spring part number is not verified to match either.

suspension.spring_rate_rear.description: Rear coil spring rate (at the spring)

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Load-test a rear spring off the car, or measure d, D, n as for the front. Precision +/-3 %.
candidates.notes: Basis: Spoon Sports JDM FL1 'normal rate' R 2.8 kgf/mm (27.5 N/mm) vs CivicXI 2023 Si owner 55.9 N/mm (5.7 kgf/mm). The leads disagree by 2x (Si may simply be stiffer, or one figure is wrong); the range spans both. Value uses the hatch-body lead. Not averaged.

suspension.motion_ratio_front.description: Front spring motion ratio (spring travel / wheel travel); wheel rate = k * MR^2

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Jack one front wheel through +/-30 mm about ride height (spring removed or with a dial gauge on the strut) and record strut compression vs wheel-centre travel.
candidates.notes: Basis: MacPherson struts are near 1:1 (strut nearly vertical, lower mount close to the wheel centre). Lead: CivicXI 2023 Si owner measured wheel/spring 1.029 (= spring/wheel 0.972). The Si shares the front lower arm part family but not verified as identical.

suspension.motion_ratio_rear.description: Rear spring motion ratio (spring travel / wheel travel); wheel rate = k * MR^2

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Measure spring-seat travel vs wheel-centre travel with the wheel jacked through +/-30 mm (or measure spring-seat and ball-joint distances from the lower arm B inner pivot).
candidates.notes: Basis: spring believed seated part-way along lower arm B (inboard of the wheel). Lead: CivicXI 2023 Si owner gives wheel/spring 1.333 (= 0.75). Rear lower arm B on the Si is a different part number (T22) from the 1.5T hatch (T20).

suspension.motion_ratio_damper_front.description: Front damper motion ratio (damper travel / wheel travel)

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Same test as the front spring motion ratio (damper is concentric with the spring).
candidates.notes: Concentric coil-over strut: damper and spring ratios are equal.

suspension.motion_ratio_damper_rear.description: Rear damper motion ratio (damper travel / wheel travel)

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Measure damper length change vs wheel-centre travel (+/-30 mm) with the wheel jacked.
candidates.notes: Basis: separate rear damper believed mounted near the knuckle, so closer to 1 than the spring; layout not confirmed.

suspension.unsprung_mass_corner_front.description: Unsprung mass per front corner (wheel, tyre, brake, knuckle, hub + share of links/strut/driveshaft)

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Weigh wheel+tyre, rotor, caliper, knuckle/hub separately on a scale; add half of strut, lower arm, driveshaft and anti-roll link masses.
candidates.notes: Basis: 18x8 alloy + 235/40R18 (~20-24 kg combined), 282 mm vented rotor and caliper (~10 kg), knuckle/hub/bearing (~8-10 kg), plus half-masses of strut, arm and driveshaft. CivicXI Si owner estimated 55 kg. Wheels/tyres thread may later supply measured wheel and tyre masses.

applicability.notes: estimate made for the target car

candidates.how_to_measure: Weigh wheel+tyre, rotor, caliper, trailing arm/knuckle and hub; add half of the four links, spring and damper.
candidates.notes: Basis: same wheel/tyre as front, 259 mm solid rotor, no driveshaft. CivicXI Si owner estimated 45 kg.

architecture.notes: Members and functions for the target car. 'status' is confirmed only where a cited page names the item for the 1.5T Sport Touring hatch; function assignments that rest on the usual Honda layout are marked inferred.

front.evidence: Independent strut front suspension • • | MacPherson Strut Front Suspension • • • •

front.description: Damper mount bearing; low-friction ball joints; spring and damper alignment optimised for low friction; larger compliance bushing
front.evidence: the front MacPherson struts feature new low-friction ball joints and front damper mount bearings to improve steering feel and self-centering. The spring and damper alignment has been optimized to minimize operational friction, and a new larger compliance bushing with an improved bushing axis minimizes harshness.

front.description: One lower control arm per side ('LOWER ARM COMP, FR', 51350-T20-A10 / 51360-T20-A10), listed for 5 Door 1.5T Sport Touring 6MT/CVT; carries the lower ball joint; two inner bushings (A-arm/L-arm) inferred
Aluminium front subframe with truss and rib structure
front.evidence: The all-new aluminum front subframe, with an efficient truss and rib structure, provides rigidity and stability.

front.description: Coil spring concentric with the strut damper (MacPherson)
front.status: inferred (MacPherson by definition; 'spring and damper alignment' in press text)

front.description: Tubular bar 26.5 mm OD x 4.5 mm wall, drop links to the struts (link mounting point inferred)
Variable-ratio EPS rack-and-pinion; rack position (ahead of/behind axle) not confirmed

rear.description: 'UPPER ARM COMP, RR' 52510-T20-A00, listed for 5 Door 1.5T Sport Touring; camber control

'Lower Arm A Complete' 52370-TGH-A00 (other name 'Front Lower Arm, Lateral Link'), listed for 5 Door 1.5T Sport Touring; front lateral link, acts as toe-control link (aftermarket 'rear toe links' replace this member - inferred)
'ARM COMP, RR- B L / R' 52355-T20-A00 / 52350-T20-A00, listed for 5 Door 1.5T Sport Touring; main rear lower arm; press text says the rear lower arms got new bushings
rear.status: confirmed (part); spring seat on this arm inferred, not confirmed
rear.evidence: New rear lower control arm bushings promote better straight-line stability and turn in, while reducing noise and vibration inside the cabin.

rear.description: 'TRAILING ARM COMP, L/R' 52365-T20-A10 / 52360-T20-A10, listed for 1.5T EX-L/Sport Touring hatch and 1.5T Touring sedan (2.0 L cars use -A00; Si/Type R use T22); longitudinal location, carries the hub
Separate spring and damper believed (spring on lower arm B, damper to knuckle/trailing arm) as in the previous Civic multi-link; NOT confirmed for this car
rear.how_to_measure: Underside photo of the rear corner (wheel off) or the Honda parts diagram 'RR. SHOCK ABSORBER / RR. LOWER ARM' image for the FL hatch.

rear.description: Solid bar 17.5 mm; link location unknown
